title: Haas Lathe — Maintenance (Interactive Service Manual)
version: RD0035, Revision A - 04/2026; official localized manual page checked 2026-11-25.
locator: Chapter 20 - Lathe Maintenance; section 20.1 Lathe Maintenance Schedule. Selected items include enclosure, axis lubrication, electrical cabinet, gearbox, pneumatics, coolant, spindle lubrication, hydraulics, probe, chuck and accessories.
